quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin on the physical demands of an 82-game season
quotes.excerpt: To go play an 82-game schedule, it was like working out and recovery was 70% of the day.
quotes.quote: I feel great for just living life, but to go play an 82-game schedule, it was like working out and recovery was 70% of the day.

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin on the importance of sleep for NBA players
quotes.excerpt: I have a problem with waking up and not being able to go back to sleep.

text_blocks.speaker: Blake Griffin
text_blocks.text: I have a problem with waking up and not being able to go back to sleep. And if it's a game day the next day, I would have sleep anxiety where you'd toss and you'd be like, 'Oh shit, okay, I could get two hours if I go back to sleep now.'

text_blocks.speaker: Lil Dicky
text_blocks.text: I can't imagine not being able to sleep and then having to go run.

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin on the pressure of playing in an NBA arena
quotes.excerpt: I had never really played in an arena or just felt the weight of the space.
quotes.quote: I had never really played in an arena or just felt the weight of the space, the weight of the depth, and the pressure of being filmed in a certain way. It's not meaningless, so as soon as I got in one of these games, I realized how it's such a different level of pressure.

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin on the difference between NBA and pickup games
quotes.excerpt: There's really good shooters on teams and there's guys that aren't as good.
quotes.quote: There's really good shooters on teams and there's guys that aren't as good, and there's guys that aren't really shooters, but you're shooting every day. Even if you're not a shooter, you're shooting every day. And you'll see the things of them going to pickup games and making it. So the pressure's different, you're not as tired, you're not having to worry about the defensive end, there's a lot of variables.

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin explains the 'zero step' in modern NBA footwork
quotes.excerpt: Your first step is called a zero step. So your first step is not really your first step.
quotes.quote: When you take a dribble, your first step is called a zero step. So your first step is not really your first step. So if I dribble and take this step, I still have two steps. Guys' footwork is so good that they can make it look really seamless and also cover a lot of space.

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin on his experience playing for the Detroit Pistons
quotes.excerpt: I'm from Oklahoma, so it kind of reminded me more of that.
quotes.quote: I'm from Oklahoma, so it kind of reminded me more of that, where I'd space and a house and neighbors weren't right on top of you. I enjoyed that part of it because during the season, I don't really go out much anyway.

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin on his concerns about chairs at public events
quotes.excerpt: I worry about chairs all the time. I've been at a wedding and set down and --
quotes.quote: I worry about chairs all the time. I've been at a wedding and set down and -- you know, like, you don't weigh a lot, but still, it's embarrassing.

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin on the importance of being prepared as an athlete
quotes.excerpt: As an athlete, you can't really focus. You have to be so locked in.
quotes.quote: As an athlete, you can't really focus. You have to be so locked in. You have to be so locked in.

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin on his strict preparation during his rookie year
quotes.excerpt: My rookie year I used to be very, very strict about everything.
quotes.quote: My rookie year I used to be very, very strict about everything, and then over time I kind of learned where I could -- because you would burn yourself out. One year I was like, 'I'm going to eat so strict,' and I went like three months of just literally nothing bad. No alcohol, very little sugar. And I fell off the wagon three months into the season.

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin on the anticipation of playoff games
quotes.excerpt: The first playoff game, yeah, it's more of an anticipation less than like a 'I'm nervous'.
quotes.quote: The first playoff game, yeah, it's more of an anticipation less than like a 'I'm nervous'.

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin on the intensity of playoff moments
quotes.excerpt: The moment is so big and you don't know what's going to happen.
quotes.quote: The moment is so big and you don't know what's going to happen. You kind of have your play, but things go out the window and you have to improvise. It never went through my mind 'What if I miss?' It was always 'What if I make it?'

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin on the nature of trash talk in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: There's certain things that you shouldn't say. You shouldn't say anything about anybody's family.
quotes.quote: There's certain things that you shouldn't say. You shouldn't say anything about anybody's family. In the NBA especially, because of the word, you shouldn't call somebody a bitch. But it happens. It will escalate it from like normal trash talk to like, 'Oh, it's like heated now.'

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin on the physical toll of an NBA career
quotes.excerpt: Every time you're when as you get older, your joints have less mobility.
quotes.quote: Every time you're when as you get older, your joints have less mobility, and Achilles are compromised when you're -- you can see how their legs are different sizes.

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin on the transactional nature of social gatherings
quotes.excerpt: Social interactions or social gatherings now are just to like have clout.
quotes.quote: Social interactions or social gatherings now are just to like have clout, and like a story to tell on their podcast, or a picture to post, you know? I think it's different. I feel like it used to be -- college for me, it was just like the best. There was no cameras, there was no...

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin on the physical presence of Charles Oakley
quotes.excerpt: Charles Oakley's hands are like probably like a little bit bigger than mine, but like each finger is like twice the width.
quotes.quote: Charles Oakley's hands are like probably like a little bit bigger than mine, but like each finger is like twice the width.

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin on the physical toll of playing in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: As you get older, your joints have less mobility and Achilles are compromised.
quotes.quote: As you get older, your joints have less mobility and Achilles are compromised when you're -- you can see how their legs are different sizes.

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin on the routine of post-game recovery
quotes.excerpt: I'm usually like feet in the ice bath, I'm like 'fuck off'.
quotes.quote: I'm usually like feet in the ice bath, I'm like 'fuck off'. Ice on my knees, I'm like 'fuck off'.

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin on the importance of player autonomy in sports
quotes.excerpt: I truly mean this, only if he actually wants to do it.
quotes.quote: I truly mean this, only if he actually wants to do it. Because he loves sports. Loves it on his own, loves basketball, loves football.
